meta.notes: Battery Production Equipment Providers, Europe, as of February 2026. Authors: Sebastian Wolf, Heiner Heimes (PEM RWTH Aachen University). Image legend — equipment categories: Electrode manufacturing (blue) · Cell assembly (teal) · Cell finishing (light teal) · Module & pack production (green) · Atmosphere conditioning (light green). Map circles show aggregate company counts per country/category; individual company logos listed by country around the map perimeter. Equipment providers typically have no specific battery project site — most records have city:null and lat/lon:null. 34 records carry logo_research_needed:true. Some very small logos in the Germany column were not legible; those companies are omitted and noted below. Omitted unreadable logos from Germany column: approximately 5–8 very small entries not identifiable even at maximum zoom.
